vikisozluk.baslik: زَمْجَرَ • (zamjara) Iq (non-past يُزَمْجِرُ (yuzamjiru), verbal noun زَمْجَرَة (zamjara))
anlam: to growl, to roar, to snarl
to make a loud noise, to be boisterous
